game.name: Motogp 10/11 (Europe)
game.desc: MotoGP 10/11 is a motorbike racing game for Xbox 360. You play with all the bikes and riders of the 2010 championship on all tracks. The career mode allows you to participate in a championship by creating your own rider and changing category (from 125 to MotoGP). You can also have a partner join you in split screen mode. MotoGP 10/11 also features a multiplayer mode capable of hosting 20 participants.
